ref.description: 'folder/file' path into the data catalog, or 'computed/name' for this dataflow's own computed output.

ext.description: File extension of `ref`, no leading dot (e.g. 'geojson', 'tif', 'png'). Required whenever `ref` is set.

ext_base.description: File extension of `ref_base`. Required whenever `ref_base` is set.

ext_comp.description: File extension of `ref_comp`. Required whenever `ref_comp` is set.
